row.title: BRANCH-SWEEP-3: port was a branch state with no exit
row.body: 61 of 69 remote branches sat in the sweep's port disposition for up to 9 days: a PORT-BRANCH item was filed and the branch kept until ported, which nothing did (53 of them already had a merged or closed pull request). An idle port branch with no open pull request now moves to refs/archive/<name> (read back before the head is deleted; restore with git fetch origin refs/archive/<name> then push FETCH_HEAD to refs/heads/<name>), and branchsweep --carried reads the archive ref so a PORT item is not closed by the branch being gone. 62 branches archived 2026-11-19; branch list 69 -> 8.
